map.晨起水肿鉴别：轻压可暂时回陷多为水肿型，提示睡眠/盐分/循环问题。: Morning edema check: light press that briefly pits suggests edema type, indicating sleep/salt/circulation issues.
map.年龄性膨出：笑或躺下不消失、光照有阴影多为脂肪型，需手术或填充思路。: Age-related bulge: does not disappear when smiling or lying down, shadow under light suggests fat type, needs surgery or filler approach.

map.眼霜能去真性眼袋吗？: Can eye cream remove true eye bags?
map.很难。脂肪膨出或韧带松驰靠护肤品改善有限，属医美/眼科范畴。: Hard. Fat bulge or ligament laxity hardly improves with skincare; it is cosmetic/ophthalmic.
map.水肿型和脂肪型怎么分？: How to distinguish edema and fat types?
map.看可复性与时段：晨重暮轻多水肿，持续膨出多脂肪，仍须医师确认。: Check reducibility and timing: morning-heavy-evening-light suggests edema, persistent bulge suggests fat; physician confirmation still needed.
map.本工具能定手术方案吗？: Can this tool decide the surgical plan?
map.不能。仅做类型初判，手术方式由专科医师评估。: No. It only gives a preliminary type judgment; the surgical method is decided by a specialist.
